mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% triggers concerns about labor market weakening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 5.0 in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 5.0 in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.65% and the unemployment rate falls below 4.8%, conflicting signals of tightening monetary policy and strengthening labor markets create negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.65 and UNRATE falls below 4.8 in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling does not occur, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices above their thresholds signals a late-cycle expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 17000 and INDPRO crosses above 105 in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO not both rising above their thresholds, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing-related demand (HOUST) above 1300 units triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it signals robust economic activity.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 1300 in the next month
failure_condition: HOUST does not cross above 1300 in the next month, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous high demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) growth above critical thresholds compresses short-term interest rates and boosts equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both exceed their 1-month moving averages in the next month
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO not both rising above their moving averages, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer demand (GDPC1) above 17000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 17000 in the next month
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross above 17000 in the next month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.65% and the unemployment rate rises above 4.8%, conflicting signals of monetary easing and labor market strain create negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 0.65 and UNRATE rises above 4.8 in the next month
regime_hint: monetary easing and labor market strain
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS falling and UNRATE rising does not occur, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
